fnol_text: My name is Owen Quinlan and I live at 775 Rowan Way, Clinton, NC 28325. You can reach me on (555) 503-3652 or owen.quinlan@example.com. On 7 October 2024 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Hannah Gallagher, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00026. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Please just tell me this is covered.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Quinlan on (555) 503-3652 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 7 October 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Ethan Rasmussen gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Hannah Gallagher reports minor burns to the hand and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Owen reports minor burns to the hand.
